description: Physical robot runner, CLI (scripts/forge_robot.py), and comprehensive unit tests for all Phase 11 modules. Depends on FEAT-001 (hardware.py, safety.py, sim2real.py must exist). The runner reuses the existing Policy interface and integrates with the recorder and safety system. Tests cover hardware abstraction, safety system, and sim-to-real utilities.
